main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x 72-bar excess forward return on positive-forecast grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with OLS slope > 0; reject if t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 72-bar forward return on forecast

decided_by: The main measure's t lies between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: The coin's mean 72-bar return is the mean over all non-overlapping grid returns of all its windows (not only positive-forecast bars), and the situation check leaves out bars whose 72-bar return cannot be computed inside their window.
